title: Claude 3.5 Haiku on AWS Trainium2 and model distillation in Amazon Bedrock

subtitle: We're bringing faster inference to Claude 3.5 Haiku through AWS Trainium2 optimization and enabling model distillation in Amazon Bedrock to help you achieve frontier-level performance at lower costs.
